title: Twelve Chapters on the Faith
author: Gregory Thaumaturgus
edition: Vossius 1684 Opera omnia Latin column (Duodecim Capita de Fide)
blurb: Gregory Thaumaturgus, Twelve Chapters on the Faith. New English for private study; ANF 6 Crombie exists.
era_note: The Twelve Chapters on the Faith stand under Gregory Thaumaturgus's name in the third-century Neocaesarean tradition; later Latin presentation is disclosed.
first_english_note: Prior English exists (ANF 6 Crombie, PD); this is a new rendering from locked Latin for the tipped capita.

text_history.method: English from locked Vossius 1684 Latin column for tip Capita I-II; Greek column OCR too damaged to lock; Vossius scholia stripped; OCR joins disclosed; ANF 6 consulted only as sense check.

joins.note: OCR of clavorum / lancea / palpandum / clausis ianuis restored from the facing column and the John 20 scene; not invented doctrine.
